network_terms.source: Affitor's terms (https://affitor.com/terms, sections 7 and 8.3, effective 2026-01-28) and payout docs (https://affitor.com/docs/brand/quickstart/payouts), both linked from every marketplace listing; read 2026-10-19. payout_conditions: the partner payout docs (https://affitor.com/docs/partners/payouts, last updated 2026-10-18; read 2026-10-21)
network_terms.payout_conditions: For commissions approved on or after October 9, 2026 at 00:00 Pacific, withdrawals require the brand to have paid the covering invoice; earlier approved commissions became withdrawable on approval. At least $20 must be available before a withdrawal request. Withdrawals undergo team review, and Wise or bank delivery timing varies. A processing fee may apply and is shown before confirmation.
restrictions: No fraudulent traffic: bots, automated scripts, fake clicks or cookie stuffing
No self-referrals: do not refer yourself or your own accounts
No bidding on the brand's keywords in paid search without its written permission
No misrepresenting your relationship with the brand or making false claims about its products
No attempts to manipulate or circumvent attribution
Disclose the affiliate relationship as the law requires, such as FTC guidelines
